text:
Lia CSM: FYI - Marigold Health renewal 45 days out. Onboarding stuck at 40% (API keys, webhooks). Usage down ~35% over last 2 weeks. Thinking a 'preemptive activation parachute' to avoid escalation. Thoughts?

Jamal (AE): Agree. Don't jump to discounts. Offer 2-week pro enablement + success workshop. @Lia CSM can we do a 1:1 demo?

Maya Ops: +1. Also recommend immediate "downgrade safety net" — keep billing intact but allow a soft downgrade with feature gates so they don't churn. I have a template playbook, will add checklist.

Lia CSM: Paste playbook checklist:

```
- 0d: triage call (30m) w/ CSM + AE
- 2d: enablement workshop (live)
- 5d: webhook sanity check (support)
- 7d: usage nudges + checklist email
- 10d: product feedback capture + ticket
- 14d: decision/renewal prep
```

Sean (Support): I'll run logs for webhook failures and check for 401/429 spikes. If I see >5% errors I'll open a P1 and loop eng. @Maya Ops which alert channel should I use?

Maya Ops: Use #eng-oncall and include @oncall. Also add a short note to the customer-facing thread.

Olivia (Product): If webhook is root cause we can push a retry fallback in ~2 business days. Tagging FH-5629. Please add sample payload + repro steps.

Lia CSM: Scheduling triage tomorrow 11am PT and sending invites. Offering a one-time activation credit (2 weeks pro) as goodwill — Jamal ok?

Jamal (AE): Ok but conditional on workshop attendance + feedback submission. No open-ended discounts.

reminders-bot: Reminder set — Triage call with Marigold Health scheduled 3632196476

Lia CSM: Assigning actions: @Sean run logs, @Maya create the downgrade-safety-net flow, @Olivia collect repros. I'll draft the customer email now and paste for review :thumbsup:

Olivia (Product): +1. Focus on outcome metrics (webhook success rate, active integrations) in the follow-up.

Lia CSM: Draft email:

"Hi Marigold team — quick plan to get you back on track: 1) 30-min triage tomorrow 11am, 2) hands-on enablement, 3) temporary activation credit, 4) fallback downgrade that preserves configs. Can you confirm availability? — Lia"

Maya Ops: Attaching internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/downgrade-safety-net

Jamal (AE): I'll lead renewal convo on the call. Team assigned — thanks, will report back with notes after triage.
